_doc: Anthropometric centroids per population/cluster. Each cluster's mean (height_cm, weight_kg, shoulder_to_hip, waist_to_hip) — used as priors for camera-only body-shape classification.

vietnamese_female.source: Trieu, Tang, Nguyen, Le (2024). 'Analysis of Vietnamese Women's Body Shape from Anthropometric Data', Vlákna a Textil 2024(1). n=480 3D body scans.

us_female.source: Lee, Istook, Nam, Park (2007). 'Comparison of body shape between USA and Korean women', IJCST 19(5). n=222 US women (FFIT 5-shape).

korean_female.source: Lee et al. (2007) + Size Korea 8th KATS survey (2020). n=259 KR women.

_population_comparison._note: Inter-population anthropometric shifts that justify country-conditioned size models.
